name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: TV app performance on Android TV boxes (measured on the Streamybox): much smoother row and vertical navigation in Home, faster detail pages and cold start, and an ART baseline profile shipped with the release (streamarr-android-tv-0.20.1.dm, installed together with the APK). Fixes: the player overlay hides by itself again, Back in the player first closes an open panel, then the overlay, and only then leaves the player, and Settings ▸ About shows the release version instead of 0.1.0. No server changes; the Jellyfin plugin itself is unchanged.
